GEOGRAPHY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Industry is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Industry with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Industry as rumours only.
   C. Say Industry never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Industry.

2. Which statement about Rocks is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Rocks never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Rocks with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Rocks.
   D. Treat Rocks as rumours only.

3. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Avoid saving forever

4. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   B. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   D. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Mining is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Mining.
   B. Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Mining never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Mining as rumours only.

6. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Destroying road signs

7. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   B. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   D. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Nakuru

9. Which statement about Earthquakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Earthquakes.
   C. Say Earthquakes never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Earthquakes as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Vulcanicity is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Vulcanicity.
   B. Treat Vulcanicity as rumours only.
   C. Explain Vulcanicity with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Vulcanicity never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   B. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   C. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Folding is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Folding with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Folding.
   C. Treat Folding as rumours only.
   D. Say Folding never happens in Kenya.

13. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

14. Which statement about Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Agriculture as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture.
   C. Say Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

15. Which statement about Introduction to Geography is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Introduction to Geography with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Introduction to Geography as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Geography.
   D. Say Introduction to Geography never happens in Kenya.

16. Which statement about Energy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Energy never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Energy.
   C. Explain Energy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Energy as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Energy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Industry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Geography and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Rocks and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Folding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Vulcanicity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Earthquakes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
